examples.text: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.

27401.commentary: (SNPa) chandatā'ti kattu'kamyatā. sā yassa balavatī hoti, tassa ijjhati.

examples.text: manussattaṃ liṅgasampatti, hetu satthāradassanaṃ, pabbajjā guṇasampatti, adhikāro ca chandatā, aṭṭhadhammasamodhānā, abhinīhāro samijjhati.

27403.meaning1: desire and ill-will; craving and aversion

examples.text: evañ'hi vuttaṃ samaṇena jānatā, tasmā hi te sappurisā pasaṃsiyā, dhamme ṭhitā ye na karonti pāpakaṃ, na chandadosā na bhayā ca gāmino, parisāya maṇḍo ca pan'esa vuccati, evañ'hi vuttaṃ samaṇena jānatā'ti.

27404.meaning1: diversity of interests; variety of impulses
27404.commentary: (DNa) saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattan'ti saṅkappanānattatāya rūpe chando sadde chando'ti evaṃ chandanānattaṃ uppajjati.

examples.text: katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? nava nānattā, dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ

27405.meaning1: with interest as source; originating in desire
27405.meaning2: originate in desire; have a source in interest
27405.commentary: (DNa) chandanidānan'ti ettha pariyesanachando, paṭilābhachando, paribhogachando, sannidhichando, vissajjanachando'ti pañcavidho chando.

examples.text: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.
yaṃ kho kiñci atītam'addhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajji sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ. chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassa.

27406.meaning1: dependent on interest; based on desire

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

27407.meaning1: produced by interest; generated by desire

examples.text: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.

27408.meaning1: (vinaya) consent and purity; consent and innocence

examples.text: chandaparisuddhi, utu'kkhānaṃ, bhikkhugaṇanā ca, ovādo, uposathassa etāni, pubbakiccan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

27409.meaning1: (vinaya) consent and purity; consent and innocence
27409.commentary: (KVa) chandapārisuddhī'ti ettha uposathakaraṇ'atthaṃ sannipatite saṅghe bahi uposathaṃ katvā āgatena sannipatitaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā kāyasāmaggiṃ adentena chando dātabbo. yo'pi gilāno vā hoti kiccappasuto vā, tenā'pi pārisuddhiṃ dentena chando'pi dātabbo.

27410.meaning2: consent, purity and announcing the seasons

27411.meaning1: for the purpose of giving up interest; for the abandoning of desire

examples.text: kim'atthiyaṃ nu kho, bho ānanda, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? chandappahān'atthaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.

27413.meaning1: rooted in interest; originating from desire; stemming from intention
27413.commentary: (ANa) chandamūlakā'ti ajjhāsayacchando kattu'kamyatāchando taṃ mūlaṃ etesan'ti chandamūlakā.

examples.text: chandamūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, manasikārasambhavā sabbe dhammā, phassasamudayā sabbe dhammā, vedanāsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā

27414.meaning1: interest and passion; desire and lust
27414.commentary: (ANa) chandarāgo'ti evaṃ akusalavitakkena vitakkite vatthusmiṃ dubbalarāgo ca balavarāgo ca uppajjati. idañ'hi idha chando'ti dubbalarāgass'ādhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.
rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, upādāniyo dhammo, yo chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.

27415.meaning1: founded on interest and passion; based on desire and lust

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati? atītānaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti.

27416.meaning1: end of interest and passion; cessation of desire and lust
27416.meaning2: end of interest and passion; cessation of desire and lust

examples.text: chandarāgo ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso chandarāge asati chandarāganirodhā api nu kho ajjhosānaṃ paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

27418.meaning1: fact of being bound to interest and desire

examples.text: iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

27420.meaning1: abandoning of interest and passion; letting go of desire and lust
27420.commentary: (MNa) chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti nibbānaṃ. nibbānañ'hi āgamma kāmesu chandarāgo vinīyati c'eva pahīyati ca, tasmā nibbānaṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti ca vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo. yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho'ti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo. yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ

27421.meaning1: interest, desire and dislike; impulse, affection and ill-will
27421.compound: dvanda (chanda ca rāga ca byāpāda ca)
27421.commentary: (MNa) chandarāgabyāpādenā'ti so avijjāsaṅkhāto visadoso chandarāgena ca byāpādena ca ruppati kuppati.

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evam'assa, taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso, chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.

27424.meaning1: due to interest and passion; under the influence of desire and lust
27424.commentary: (ANa) chandarāgavas'ūpetā'ti chandassa ca rāgassa ca vasaṃ upetā.

examples.text: ye ca rūpe pamāṇiṃsu, ye ca ghosena anvagū, chandarāgavas'ūpetā, n'ābhijānanti te janā.

27425.meaning1: removal of interest and passion; dispelling of desire and lust (for)
27425.commentary: (MNa) chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti nibbānaṃ. nibbānañ'hi āgamma kāmesu chandarāgo vinīyati c'eva pahīyati ca, tasmā nibbānaṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti ca vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo. yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ

yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo. yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho'ti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.

27426.meaning1: teaching the removal of interest and passion (for)

examples.text: paṇḍitā h'āvuso manussā vīmaṃsakā kismiṃ pan'āyasmantānaṃ chandarāgavinayakkhāyī satthā'ti

27427.meaning1: bound by interest and passion; held captive by desire and lust

27428.meaning1: removing interest and passion; dispelling desire and lust
27428.meaning2: removal of interest and passion; dispelling desire and lust
27428.commentary: (NIDD2) chandarāgavinodanan'ti chandarāgappahānaṃ chandarāgavūpasamaṃ chandarāgapaṭinissaggaṃ chandarāgapaṭippassaddhaṃ amataṃ nibbānan'ti, chandarāgavinodanaṃ.

examples.text: idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.

27429.meaning1: difference between (types of) interest and passion (in); distinction between (kinds of) desire and lust (for)

examples.text: siyā pana, bhante, pañc'upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatā'ti?

27430.commentary: (SNa) chando nidānan'ti gāyatti-ādiko chando gāthānaṃ nidānaṃ. pubbapaṭṭhāpanagāthā ārabhanto hi, kataracchandena hotū'ti ārabhati.
27430.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.
ime vuccanti padhānasaṅkhārā'ti. iti ayañ'ca chando, ayañ'ca chandasamādhi, ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo.

27432.meaning1: comprised of meditative composure based on interest and active effort
27432.commentary: (VIBHa) chandasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgatan'ti ettha chandahetuko chand'ādhiko vā samādhi chandasamādhi. kattu'kamyatāchandaṃ adhipatiṃ karitvā paṭiladdhasamādhiss'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. padhānabhūtā saṅkhārā padhānasaṅkhārā. catukiccasādhakassa sammappadhānavīriyass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. samannāgatan'ti chandasamādhinā ca padhānasaṅkhārehi ca upetaṃ.

examples.text: so chandasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, cittasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīmaṃsāsamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, ussoḷhī'y'eva pañcamī.

27433.meaning1: comprised of meditative composure based on interest and active effort
27433.commentary: (DNa) chandasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgatan'ti-ādīsu chandahetuko chand'ādhiko vā samādhi chandasamādhi, kattu'kamyatāchandaṃ adhipatiṃ karitvā paṭiladdhasamādhiss'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. padhānabhūtā saṅkhārā padhānasaṅkhārā.

examples.text: idha, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu chandasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti

27434.meaningLit: discourse on meditative composure based on interest

27435.meaning1: with interest as source; originating from impulse

examples.text: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.

27436.meaning1: accomplishment of one's desire; (comm) accomplishment of the desire to do good

examples.text: sīlasampannass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ… yadidaṃ, chandasampadā… yadidaṃ, attasampadā… yadidaṃ, diṭṭhisampadā… yadidaṃ, appamādasampadā…

27438.meaning1: wife who lives with a husband by choice
27438.meaning2: wife obtained with her free will
27438.commentary: (VINa) chandena attano ruciyā vasatī'ti chandavāsinī. yasmā pana sā na attano chandamatten'eva bhariyā hoti purisena pana sampaṭicchitattā, tasm'āssa niddese, piyo piyaṃ vāsetī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: dasa bhariyāyo, dhanakkītā chandavāsinī bhogavāsinī paṭavāsinī odapattakinī obhaṭacumbaṭā dāsī ca bhariyā ca kammakārī ca bhariyā ca dhaj'āhaṭā muhuttikā.

27439.meaning1: removal of interest; removal of desire

examples.text: chandajaṃ aghaṃ chandajaṃ dukkhaṃ, chandavinayā aghavinayo, aghavinayā dukkhavinayo'ti.

27440.meaning1: due to the subsiding of desire

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi… chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandavūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkavūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāvūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

27441.meaning1: rule about leaving (a legal action) without giving consent; Pācittiya 80

27442.meaning1: wrongdoing due to desire; incorrect course of action based on impulse
27442.meaning2: wrong way of behaviour under an impulse
27442.commentary: (VINa) yo na chand'āgatin'ti-ādīsu lobhavasena taṃ vatthuṃ attano vā karonto attānaṃ vā ukkaṃsento chand'āgatiṃ nāma gacchati. (DNa) chand'āgatiṃ gacchanto'ti chandena pemena agatiṃ gacchanto akattabbaṃ karonto.

examples.text: yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvako n'eva chand'āgatiṃ gacchati, na dos'āgatiṃ gacchati, na moh'āgatiṃ gacchati, na bhay'āgatiṃ gacchati, imehi catūhi ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karotī'ti.

no ce chaḍḍeti, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu rūpiyachaḍḍako sammannitabbo, yo na chand'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dos'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na moh'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhay'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, chaḍḍit'āchaḍḍitañ'ca jāneyya.

27443.commentary: (NIDD1) chandānidānāni piyāni loke'ti. piyā chandanidānā chandasamudayā chandajātikā chandapabhavāti, chandānidānāni piyāni loke.

27444.meaning1: led by interest (in); pulled along by the impulse (for); led by desire (for)
27444.commentary: (NIDD1) chand'ānunīto'ti sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā yāyati niyyati vuyhati saṃharīyati. yathā hatthiyānena vā assayānena vā rathayānena vā goyānena vā ajayānena vā meṇḍayānena vā oṭṭhayānena vā kharayānena vā yāyati niyyati vuyhati saṃharīyati, evam'eva sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā yāyati niyyati vuyhati saṃharīyatī'ti, chand'ānunīto.

examples.text: gandhañ'ca ghatvā surabhiṃ manoramaṃ, atho'pi ghatvā asuciṃ akantiyaṃ, akantiyasmiṃ paṭighaṃ vinodaye, chand'ānunīto na ca kantiye siyā.
sakañ'hi diṭṭhiṃ katham'accayeyya, chand'ānunīto ruciyā niviṭṭho, sayaṃ samattāni pakubbamāno, yathā hi jāneyya tathā vadeyya.

27445.meaning1: entitled to give consent by proxy; fit to give agreement
27445.meaning2: entitled to give consent by proxy; is fit give agreement

examples.text: pānīya-paribhojanīya-upaṭṭhapanañ'ca, chand'ārahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chand'āharaṇañ'ca, tesaññ'eva akat'uposathānaṃ pārisuddhiyā'pi āharaṇañ'ca

27446.meaning2: name of a class of Brahmans

examples.text: pānīya-paribhojanīy'upaṭṭhapanañ'ca, chand'ārahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chand'āharaṇañ'ca, tesaññ'eva akat'uposathānaṃ pārisuddhiyā'pi āharaṇañ'ca

27448.meaning1: conveying consent and purity; carrying approval and innocence

examples.text: chand'āharaṇa-pārisuddhi-āharaṇāni, pana imissaṃ sīmāyaṃ hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā nisinnānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhāvato n'atthi.

27452.meaning1: connected with interest; to do with desire
27452.commentary: (MNa) chand'ūpasaṃhitā'ti chandasahagatā rāgasampayuttā. imesaṃ pana tiṇṇaṃ vitakkānaṃ khettañ'ca ārammaṇañ'ca jānitabbaṃ. tattha chand'ūpasañhitānaṃ aṭṭha lobhasahagatacittāni khettaṃ, dos'ūpasañhitānaṃ dve domanassasahagatāni, moh'ūpasañhitānaṃ dvādasa'pi akusalacittāni. vicikicchā-uddhacca-sampayutta-cittāni pana dve etesaṃ pāṭipuggalikaṃ khettaṃ.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.

27453.meaning2: according to one's will; voluntarily; willingly; according to (one's own) wishes

27454.meaning1: chief priest; name of a group of Brahmans
27454.meaning2: chief priest; name of a class of Brahmans
27454.commentary: (DNt) chando vuccati visesato sāmavedo, taṃ sarena kāyantī'ti chandokā, sāmavedino. chandogā'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, so ev'attho.

examples.text: magg'āmagge, bho gotama. kiñ'c'āpi, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā nānāmagge paññapenti, addhariyā brāhmaṇā tittiriyā brāhmaṇā chandokā brāhmaṇā bavhārijjhā brāhmaṇā, atha kho sabbāni tāni niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa brahmasahabyatāya.

27455.synonym: avacchādita, āvaṭa, āvuṭa, āvuta, guḷha, chādita, nilīna, paṭicchanna, līna, saṃvuta

examples.text: patirūpako mattikākuṇḍalo'va, loh'aḍḍhamāso'va suvaṇṇachanno, caranti loke parivārachannā, anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā'ti.
pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.
pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
santi kho pana me, udāyi, sāvakā rukkhamūlikā abbhokāsikā, te aṭṭhamāse channaṃ na upenti.

27461.meaning1: name of an arahant monk who committed suicide
27461.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
27461.notes: Theragāthā verse 69 (TH1.69, TH69) is attributed to him.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ channaṃ etadavoca, kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ?

27466.meaning2: Chapter 9 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

27467.grammar: card, x dat pl of cha

examples.text: ayaṃyev'ettha attho, vaṇo'ti kho, sunakkhatta, chann'etaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, visadoso'ti kho, sunakkhatta, avijjāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ

27468.grammar: card, x gen pl of cha

examples.text: channaṃ tv'eva, phagguna, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho
yato kho, āvuso, bhikkhu channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī'ti.

27469.meaning1: for the six, this; of the six, this

examples.text: cha dvārā'ti kho, bhikkhu, chann'etaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ. dovāriko'ti kho, bhikkhu, satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. sīghaṃ dūtayuga'nti kho, bhikkhu, samathavipassanān'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, bārāṇasiyaṃ aññatarassa chapakassa pajāpati gabbhinī ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, sā chapakī taṃ chapakaṃ etadavoca, gabbhinī'mhi, ayyaputta!

27475.meaning2: measuring the height of six men

27476.commentary: (VINa) chappañcavācāhī'ti chahi pañcahi vācāhi yo deseti, tassa'pi anāpatti. tattha eko gāthāpādo ekavācā'ti evaṃ sabbattha vācāpamāṇaṃ veditabbaṃ. sace aṭṭhakathaṃ dhammapadaṃ jātakādivatthuṃ vā kathetu'kāmo hoti, chappañcapadamattam'eva kathetuṃ vaṭṭati. pāḷiyā saddhiṃ kathentena ekapadaṃ pāḷito pañca aṭṭhakathāto'ti evaṃ cha padāni anatikkāmetvāva kathetabbo.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmassa uttarichappañcavācāhi dhammaṃ deseyya aññatra viññunā purisaviggahena, pācittiyaṃ.

27478.meaning2: lasting for five or six years
